evals.prompt: I'm a cement chemist working on silicate dissolution and carbonation. Set up a Karpathy-style LLM wiki over my Zotero papers in WIKI_DIR (plain local folder, not synced). It should cover my Zotero collection Materials/Cement/silicate dissolution. Then do a first ingest of one paper from that collection so I can see what a source page looks like. Don't wait for me to choose emphasis, just pick a paper with a PDF and go.
evals.expected_output: A new wiki in WIKI_DIR with the schema and tools, tests and strict lint passing, one source page read from rendered PDF pages and stamped, a topic page for the collection, index and log updated, one commit; Zotero untouched.

evals.prompt: can you set up a zotero-backed knowledge base for my PhD notes in WIKI_DIR? heads up, that folder syncs with Dropbox. I'm a chem eng PhD student doing solubility and crystallization modeling (my Zotero collection is Phase Equilibria/Crystallization). Don't read any papers yet, just get it set up and tell me what to do next.
evals.expected_output: A new wiki in WIKI_DIR with the git directory outside the synced folder, the audience sentence about crystallization/solubility modeling, tests and lint passing, no source pages, and next steps naming the collection.

evals.prompt: My Zotero wiki at WIKI_DIR was made a while ago and I heard the wiki tools have been improved (portable Zotero data dir, generated citekeys without Better BibTeX). Update its tools to the latest version without touching any of my pages or my AGENTS.md, and confirm everything still checks out.
evals.expected_output: Only tools/*.py replaced (with backups), pages/AGENTS.md/logs unchanged, tests and strict lint passing on the existing wiki, and a summary of what changed.
